name: hold-to-confirm
title: Hold to Confirm
description: Press and hold to confirm: a ring fills around the icon and turns into a check mark.

perf.budget: One linear timing and three trimmed Skia paths while holding; nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The progress ring and fill still advance (they carry information); the press scale is reduced to 1%.
a11y.screenReader: Button role. Double tap and hold ('longpress' action) confirms; a single double tap announces how to use it. Confirmation is announced.
a11y.touchTarget: 56 pt tall, at least 200 pt wide.
